title: How the crash happened
summary: Brown, unused to the fluid-drive car, braked into a skid and hit a bridge; Chu Berry was thrown clear and, delirious, hit a doctor at the hospital.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Well, you know how that happened? You see, you know, Brown was driving. Lamar let him drive. The car was a fluid drive.

And Brown was not used to a fluid drive, you see. Your differential, your transmission, when you had it in fluid drive, it didn't have no pull on it, you see. So if you put on your brakes, the car would go into a skid, you see?
Uh-huh, and that's what he did.
And they went into this skid and they hit the left side of a stone bridge, a concrete bridge, --

-- and the car went in just like that and turned over and it threw Chu Ghee clear of it. And he was a big man naturally, so when they took him to the hospital, he was so big and he was out of his head and the doctor came to him to try to help him, tried to get close to him, and Chu Ghee hit him and knocked him way across the room, --
Well, he wanted to -- he tried to get up to go because he wanted to keep on the trip.
